title: David vs Goliath
summary: A young shepherd boy defeats a giant warrior with a single stone and his faith in God.
moral: Faith and courage can overcome any obstacle.
hooks: A boy with a stone defeated the most feared warrior alive...

title: Noah's Ark
summary: God instructs Noah to build an ark to save his family and two of every animal from a great flood.
moral: Obedience to God brings salvation even when the world doubts you.
hooks: God told one man to build a boat... and the entire world laughed.

title: Moses Parts the Red Sea
summary: Moses raises his staff and God parts the Red Sea, allowing the Israelites to escape from Egypt.
moral: When God makes a way, nothing can stand in your path.
hooks: An entire ocean split in half... and a nation walked through on dry ground.

title: Daniel in the Lion's Den
summary: Daniel is thrown into a den of lions for praying to God, but God sends an angel to shut the lions' mouths.
moral: God protects those who remain faithful to Him.
hooks: They threw him to the lions... but God had other plans.

title: Jonah and the Whale
summary: Jonah runs from God's command, is swallowed by a great fish, and after three days prays and is released.
moral: You cannot run from God's purpose for your life.
hooks: He ran from God... and ended up inside a whale for three days.

title: The Burning Bush
summary: Moses encounters a bush that burns but is not consumed, and God speaks to him from the flames.
moral: God can speak to you anywhere when you are willing to listen.
hooks: A bush was on fire... but it never burned. Then God spoke.

title: Joseph and His Dreams
summary: Joseph is sold into slavery by his brothers but rises to become the second most powerful man in Egypt.
moral: What others mean for evil, God can turn into good.
hooks: His own brothers sold him as a slave... he became ruler of a nation.

title: The Creation of the World
summary: In six days, God creates the heavens, the earth, the seas, all living things, and humanity.
moral: Everything you see was spoken into existence by God.
hooks: In the beginning, there was nothing. Then God spoke.

title: Adam and Eve in the Garden
summary: Adam and Eve live in paradise until they eat the forbidden fruit, bringing sin into the world.
moral: Disobedience has consequences, but God still provides a way forward.
hooks: They had everything... but one fruit changed the fate of all humanity.

title: Abraham's Test of Faith
summary: God tests Abraham by asking him to sacrifice his son Isaac, but provides a ram at the last moment.
moral: God will always provide when you trust Him completely.
hooks: God asked him to sacrifice his only son... what happened next changed everything.

title: The Tower of Babel
summary: Humanity tries to build a tower to reach heaven, but God confuses their languages and scatters them.
moral: Pride leads to confusion; humility leads to unity with God.
hooks: They tried to build a stairway to heaven... God had a different plan.

title: Samson and Delilah
summary: The strongest man alive falls for Delilah, who betrays his secret to his enemies.
moral: Even the strongest can fall when they compromise their calling.
hooks: The strongest man who ever lived... brought down by love and betrayal.

title: The Good Samaritan
summary: A Samaritan helps a wounded stranger on the road after a priest and a Levite pass him by.
moral: Your neighbor is anyone who needs your help, regardless of who they are.
hooks: Two religious men walked by... the one everyone hated stopped to save him.

title: The Prodigal Son
summary: A son takes his inheritance, wastes it all, and returns home to find his father running to embrace him.
moral: No matter how far you have fallen, you can always come home to God.
hooks: He wasted everything and had nothing left... then his father did the unexpected.

title: The Resurrection of Jesus
summary: Three days after crucifixion, Jesus rises from the dead and appears to his followers.
moral: Death is not the end. Hope always rises again.
hooks: They sealed the tomb with a massive stone... but death could not hold Him.

title: Jesus Walks on Water
summary: During a storm, Jesus walks on the sea toward his disciples' boat, and Peter briefly walks on water too.
moral: Keep your eyes on Jesus, not on the storm around you.
hooks: In the middle of a storm, a figure appeared walking on the water...

title: Feeding the 5,000
summary: Jesus feeds a crowd of 5,000 people with just five loaves of bread and two fish.
moral: Give God what little you have, and He will multiply it beyond measure.
hooks: Five loaves. Two fish. Five thousand people. Do the math.

title: Jesus Raises Lazarus
summary: Jesus arrives four days after Lazarus dies and commands him to come out of the tomb alive.
moral: It is never too late for God to bring life where there is death.
hooks: He was dead for four days. Then Jesus said two words...

title: The Ten Commandments
summary: God gives Moses the Ten Commandments on stone tablets atop Mount Sinai.
moral: God gives us boundaries because He loves us, not to restrict us.
hooks: On a mountain covered in fire and smoke, God wrote ten rules with His own finger.

title: The Walls of Jericho
summary: The Israelites march around Jericho for seven days, blow their trumpets, and the walls collapse.
moral: God's methods may seem foolish to the world, but they always work.
hooks: They didn't use weapons. They didn't use siege towers. They just... walked.

title: Ruth and Naomi
summary: Ruth refuses to leave her mother-in-law Naomi and follows her to Bethlehem, where she finds redemption.
moral: Loyalty and love lead to blessings beyond what you can imagine.
hooks: She had every reason to leave... but she said, 'Where you go, I will go.'

title: Elijah and the Prophets of Baal
summary: Elijah challenges 450 prophets of Baal to a contest, and God sends fire from heaven to prove He is real.
moral: The one true God will always make Himself known.
hooks: 450 prophets vs one man. They screamed for hours. Then Elijah prayed once.

title: Jesus in Gethsemane
summary: Jesus prays in agony in the Garden of Gethsemane the night before His crucifixion.
moral: Even in your darkest hour, surrender to God's will brings strength.
hooks: The night before He died, Jesus prayed so hard that He sweat drops of blood.

title: The Fiery Furnace
summary: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego are thrown into a blazing furnace for refusing to worship a golden idol, but God saves them.
moral: Stand for what is right, even if you stand in fire.
hooks: The king heated the furnace seven times hotter... but they walked out without a single burn.

title: The Parable of the Sower
summary: Jesus tells of a farmer whose seeds fall on different types of ground, each representing how people receive God's word.
moral: The same message can change your life or be forgotten — it depends on your heart.
hooks: A farmer threw seeds everywhere... but only one type of ground produced fruit.

title: The Crucifixion of Jesus
summary: Jesus is crucified on a cross between two criminals, forgiving those who nailed Him there.
moral: The greatest act of love was dying for people who did not deserve it.
hooks: As they nailed Him to the cross, He said, 'Father, forgive them.'

title: The Parable of the Lost Sheep
summary: A shepherd leaves his 99 sheep to find the one that is lost, and rejoices when he finds it.
moral: You are never too lost for God to come looking for you.
hooks: He had 99 sheep safe at home... but he went into the wilderness for the one.

title: Water Turned to Wine
summary: At a wedding in Cana, Jesus performs His first miracle by turning water into the finest wine.
moral: Jesus can transform the ordinary into something extraordinary.
hooks: The wine ran out at the wedding. Then Jesus did something no one expected.

title: The Ten Plagues of Egypt
summary: God sends ten devastating plagues upon Egypt to convince Pharaoh to free the Israelites.
moral: No power on earth can stand against the will of God.
hooks: The river turned to blood. Then came frogs, darkness, and death... all because one king said no to God.

title: The Lord Is My Shepherd
summary: David writes the most beloved psalm declaring God as his shepherd who guides, protects, and restores him.
moral: Even in the valley of the shadow of death, you have nothing to fear.
hooks: These six verses have comforted more people than any other words ever written.

title: Cain and Abel
summary: Cain kills his brother Abel out of jealousy after God accepts Abel's offering but rejects Cain's.
moral: Jealousy and unchecked anger can destroy the people closest to you.
hooks: The first murder in history... and it was a brother who pulled the trigger.

title: Jacob Wrestles with God
summary: Jacob wrestles with a mysterious figure all night and refuses to let go until he receives a blessing. He is renamed Israel.
moral: When you wrestle with God and refuse to give up, He transforms you.
hooks: He fought God all night long... and refused to let go until he was blessed.

title: Baby Moses in the Basket
summary: To save her baby from Pharaoh's death order, Moses' mother places him in a basket on the Nile. Pharaoh's own daughter finds and raises him.
moral: God can use even your enemies to protect your destiny.
hooks: A mother put her baby in a river to save his life... and a princess pulled him out.

title: Gideon's 300 Warriors
summary: God reduces Gideon's army from 32,000 to just 300 men, then uses torches and trumpets to defeat a massive enemy army.
moral: God does not need large numbers. He needs willing hearts.
hooks: 32,000 soldiers showed up. God said, 'Too many.' He kept only 300.

title: Solomon's Wisdom
summary: Two women claim the same baby. King Solomon orders the child to be cut in half, revealing the true mother who gives up her claim to save the child.
moral: True love is willing to lose everything to protect what it loves.
hooks: A king ordered a baby to be cut in half... and it was the wisest decision ever made.

title: Esther Saves Her People
summary: Queen Esther risks her life by approaching the king uninvited to expose a plot to destroy her people.
moral: Perhaps you were placed exactly where you are for such a time as this.
hooks: She wasn't supposed to speak. If she did, she could die. She spoke anyway.
tags: for such a time as this

title: The Trials of Job
summary: Job loses everything — his wealth, children, and health — yet refuses to curse God, and is eventually restored double.
moral: Suffering does not mean God has abandoned you. Hold on.
hooks: He lost his children, his wealth, and his health in a single day... but he never cursed God.

title: Valley of Dry Bones
summary: God shows Ezekiel a valley full of dry bones and commands him to prophesy. The bones come together and rise as a living army.
moral: What looks dead and hopeless to you is still alive in God's hands.
hooks: A valley full of dead bones. God said, 'Speak to them.' And they stood up.

title: Balaam's Talking Donkey
summary: A prophet named Balaam beats his donkey for stopping on the road, not knowing an angel with a sword blocks the path. God opens the donkey's mouth to speak.
moral: Sometimes God uses the most unexpected things to save you from yourself.
hooks: He beat his donkey three times. Then the donkey turned around and spoke.

title: The Birth of Jesus
summary: Mary and Joseph travel to Bethlehem where Jesus is born in a manger. Angels announce his birth to shepherds in the fields.
moral: The greatest King was born in the humblest place.
hooks: No room at the inn. No royal palace. The Savior of the world was born in a barn.

title: The Wise Men Follow the Star
summary: Wise men from the East follow a miraculous star to find the newborn King, bringing gifts of gold, frankincense, and myrrh.
moral: When you seek God with all your heart, He will guide your path.
hooks: They traveled thousands of miles following a single star... to find a baby in a manger.

title: The Baptism of Jesus
summary: Jesus is baptized by John the Baptist in the Jordan River. The heavens open, the Spirit descends like a dove, and God speaks.
moral: Even Jesus humbled Himself. True greatness starts with humility.
hooks: The sky tore open. A dove came down. And a voice from heaven said, 'This is my Son.'

title: Jesus Tempted in the Desert
summary: After fasting 40 days in the desert, Satan tempts Jesus three times with power, wealth, and glory. Jesus resists every time with scripture.
moral: Every temptation has an expiration date if you stand firm.
hooks: 40 days with no food. Then the devil showed up with three offers.

title: Jesus Heals the Blind Man
summary: Jesus puts mud on the eyes of a man born blind and tells him to wash in the Pool of Siloam. The man sees for the first time in his life.
moral: What the world calls hopeless, Jesus calls an opportunity.
hooks: Blind since birth. Then a stranger put mud on his eyes... and he could see.

title: The Woman at the Well
summary: Jesus speaks with a Samaritan woman at a well, revealing He knows her past, and offers her living water that never runs dry.
moral: No matter your past, Jesus meets you exactly where you are.
hooks: She came to the well to draw water. She left with something she never expected.

title: Zacchaeus the Tax Collector
summary: Zacchaeus, a hated tax collector, climbs a tree to see Jesus. Jesus calls him down and dines at his house, transforming his life.
moral: No one is too far gone for God's grace to reach them.
hooks: He was the most hated man in town. He climbed a tree. Then Jesus looked up.

title: The Last Supper
summary: Jesus shares a final meal with His disciples, breaks bread, shares wine, and reveals that one of them will betray Him.
moral: The most sacred moments often come right before the hardest ones.
hooks: Twelve men sat at a table. One of them was about to betray the Son of God.

title: Paul's Conversion on the Damascus Road
summary: Saul, a violent persecutor of Christians, is blinded by a light from heaven on the road to Damascus. Jesus speaks to him, and he becomes the apostle Paul.
moral: God can turn your greatest enemy into your greatest champion.
hooks: He was hunting Christians to kill them. Then a light from heaven knocked him off his horse.

title: Peter's Escape from Prison
summary: Peter is chained in prison between two soldiers. An angel appears, the chains fall off, and Peter walks out past every guard.
moral: No prison can hold you when God decides to set you free.
hooks: Chained between two guards. Maximum security. Then an angel tapped him on the shoulder.

title: The Road to Emmaus
summary: Two disciples walk with a stranger who explains the scriptures to them. When He breaks bread, they realize it was Jesus all along.
moral: Sometimes Jesus is walking right beside you and you do not even know it.
hooks: They walked for miles with a stranger. When He broke the bread... their eyes opened.

title: The Day of Pentecost
summary: The Holy Spirit descends on the disciples like tongues of fire, and they begin speaking in languages they never learned.
moral: God equips ordinary people to do extraordinary things.
hooks: A sound like a rushing wind. Tongues of fire on their heads. Then they spoke in languages they never learned.
